limits: Full dictionary/rule/word/clause orchestration and the original PiperVoice/Hermes factory remain separately gated until complete combined native comparisons pass.
Original eSpeak waveform/audio-device synthesis is outside this Piper phonemizer component.
Inputs are valid controller-created first-stage lists with two terminating pauses; truncated counts and output capacity are rejected explicitly.
Retained buffer caller writes exercise the ownership contract; they are defined test inputs and are not presented as a complete eSpeak waveform consumer.

native_authoring_only.expected_generation: Actual unmodified packaged MakePhonemeList and original compiled phoneme programs. The candidate implementation was never used to produce expected output.
native_authoring_only.output_initialization: All final output slots are explicitly zeroed for the isolated clause and edge corpora, so every compared field is defined. The independent retained-state corpus uses defined nonzero initial buffers and controlled subsequent caller writes.
native_authoring_only.real_input_boundary: Capture actual first-stage lists after the packaged full text call, then call original MakePhonemeList again on that defined state. These are real clause-derived inputs; this proof does not claim observation before the original initial MakePhonemeList call.
native_authoring_only.resources: All original compiled phoneme data from the reviewed wheel; no phrase-output table used by production.

preserved: Original caller mutation and backing-array compaction order, including deleted source offsets and table-switch flags.

scope: Original MakePhonemeList, SubstitutePhonemes, SetRegressiveVoicing and re-interpretation with caller-owned first-stage state, active phoneme maps and retained output buffers. This is a phonemizer component, not an enabled complete Piper provider.
